fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry headline/articleBody-style fields spread verbatim from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, the Google News sitemap) carry title/link-style fields only.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-jsonld (article page NewsArticle block), S2-sitemap (Google News sitemap), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed article extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_500, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail (e.g. exception repr), present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description/summary (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article body (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle). Absent/missing entirely on genuinely paywalled Moneycontrol PRO / moneycontrol-research articles -- see README for the paywall verdict.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Article keywords/tags, comma-separated string (article mode from JSON-LD NewsArticle, or latest mode from the sitemap's news:keywords).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Site section/category the article belongs to (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: Article language code (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Publish timestamp, ISO 8601 with IST offset (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified timestamp (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline (article mode; raw passthrough object from JSON-LD -- {'@type':'Person','name':...,'url':...}. A wire-service byline like 'Bloomberg' or the generic staff byline 'Moneycontrol News' are both common.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization object (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle -- always Moneycontrol/NewsMediaOrganization).

image.title: Image(s)
image.description: Article image URL(s). A list of URL strings in article mode (JSON-LD), a single URL string in latest mode (sitemap image:loc).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Only present on Moneycontrol PRO / moneycontrol-research paywalled content, as the literal string "False" (not a boolean) -- when present, articleBody is missing/truncated. Absent entirely on normal free articles.

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text (latest mode; from the Google News sitemap's news:title element).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL (latest mode; from the sitemap's <loc> element).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: Publish timestamp, ISO 8601 with IST offset (latest mode; from the sitemap's news:publication_date element).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
